2026-09-02 (run 33536362659 / job 99951530156, main c2429f29): job died 5 min in at rollout engine init - one of 8 colocated vLLM replicas (TP=1, host 192.168.9.117) hit 'torch.distributed.DistNetworkError: The server socket has failed to listen ... port: 42121 ... EADDRINUSE' inside vLLM's internal init_distributed_environment (vllm_ascend/worker/worker.py:992), EngineCore failed to start -> LLMServerManager.create -> job dead; the checking step then failed with 'no valid step in log'. The port is vLLM-internal (no dist-init flag in the serve argv); verl's race-safe held sockets (get_free_port with_alive_sock=True) only cover verl's own master/dp ports. Matches verl issue #6677 (open, 2026-08-04): vLLM's single-node MultiprocExecutor picks the init port via probe-bind-release get_open_port(), two engines on one node can collide; maintainers concluded it is NOT fixable in verl (vLLM ignores external ports on this path) and track the fix at vllm-project/vllm#39015; verl fix PRs #7230 and #7504 were closed unmerged. First manifestation in the nightly in kit history (~15 prior green runs of the same asyncio.gather launch path; #7115 at HEAD did not change startup concurrency). No action; if it recurs, re-raise on #6677 with the NPU nightly as evidence. STATUS 2026-09-03: did NOT recur - job GREEN (run 33659656850 / job 100346793725).
